## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run format:check`, `lint`, `typecheck` and `test:coverage` pass in each changed package
- [ ] New behaviour has tests for valid and invalid input; bug fixes have a regression test
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or `.env` files are committed
- [ ] No new `console` calls, hardcoded URLs or magic numbers
- [ ] Database changes come with a migration
- [ ] Docs (`README`, `docs/api.md`, `.env*.example`) updated where behaviour changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-visible changes
